primary_receipt.rationale: Muse Glimmer's own advisory already recommended CLOUD_REQUIRED (real provider unspecified, X20 secrets-management risk). Independent of that, ADR-038 gives Med-high no whole-task local-repair budget, and this task is a single cohesive worker module (6 files, one directory), not an ADR-040-qualified disjoint multi-file split -- so the primary receipt would hold CLOUD_REQUIRED even had the advisory said GO_LOCAL. No upgrade to GO_LOCAL is being attempted.

gate_decision.reason: Muse Glimmer recommended CLOUD_REQUIRED; the primary cannot upgrade this to local.
